BrochureContent.Content:
Joe Organ Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 6 Marwood Lawn, a superb four-bedroom detached family home set within one of Glanmire’s most sought-after residential developments. Enjoying an enviable position overlooking a private green area and benefiting from elevated views across the Glanmire Valley, this impressive home offers generous living accommodation, excellent outdoor space, and a wonderful family-friendly setting.

From the moment you arrive, No. 6 Marwood Lawn makes an immediate impression. A private driveway provides off-street parking, while subtle exterior lighting and gated side access on both sides enhance both convenience and privacy.

Inside, a bright and welcoming tiled hallway sets the tone for the accommodation throughout. To the left, the elegant main living room is flooded with natural light from a large bay window and features a stylish white mantelpiece with an inset electric stove, creating a warm and inviting focal point. Contemporary light grey flooring and glazed double doors add to the room’s bright and spacious feel.

To the rear of the property, a second reception room offers exceptional versatility and is currently used as a family room and playroom. With sliding doors opening directly onto the sunny rear garden, this space seamlessly connects indoor and outdoor living and could easily be incorporated into a future open-plan layout if desired.

The kitchen is both practical and spacious, featuring a U-shaped design with generous storage and worktop space. Cream cabinetry, a range-style cooker, and dual aspects overlooking the garden and decking area create a bright and functional family hub. A separate utility room provides valuable additional storage and laundry facilities.

Upstairs, the property offers four well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom enjoys stunning views across the valley, extensive fitted wardrobes, and the added luxury of a private ensuite shower room. Three further bedrooms provide flexible accommodation for growing families, guest rooms, home offices, or dressing rooms, all benefiting from excellent natural light and generous proportions.

A spacious family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation and features a bath with overhead shower, tiled finishes, and modern sanitary ware.

Outside, the south-facing rear garden is a standout feature of the home. With a combination of patio and decking areas, it provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, and family enjoyment. The generous garden offers ample room for children to play while still leaving plenty of space for gardening enthusiasts to create their ideal outdoor retreat.

No. 6 Marwood Lawn combines spacious accommodation, versatile living areas, and a highly desirable location to create an exceptional family home. Situated close to excellent schools, local shops, sporting facilities, and all the amenities Glanmire has to offer, don't miss out on this rare opportunity to secure a forever home in one of Cork’s most established and sought-after suburban communities.

For more information or to arrange a private viewing contact Joe Organ Auctioneers
